ig_caption:
Your Kubernetes CronJob is running 3 times at once. 🔁

AI wrote this CronJob:
⚠️ schedule: every minute
⚠️ each run takes ~3 minutes
⚠️ concurrencyPolicy not set → the default is Allow, so runs overlap

The runs pile up: 3 copies at once, all hitting the same orders API.

The fix:
✅ concurrencyPolicy: Forbid (skip a run while one is still going)
✅ startingDeadlineSeconds + activeDeadlineSeconds (a stuck run gets killed)

Same schedule → one run at a time.

Share this with your K8s team 🔁 and follow for more fixes like this.

yt_title: Kubernetes CronJob runs 3 copies at once. AI wrote it #kubernetes
yt_description:
Real run on a local kind cluster:
- CronJob every minute, each run ~3 minutes, no concurrencyPolicy (default Allow): 3 pods Running at the same time
- fix: concurrencyPolicy: Forbid, startingDeadlineSeconds and activeDeadlineSeconds: one run at a time

Use Replace instead of Forbid if the newest run should win.
